notes.title: Don't Pray To Satan - Day 1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Based off of some feedback we've gotten, we've decided to throw out a quick hotfix for some issues we've been seeing. 

Balancing

    Satanist influence reduced inside buildings
    Satanic Altar influence reduced
    Sanctuary Zen generation reduced
    Sanctuary Zen cost increased to 1350


Quality of Life

    Added a clearer Tutorial button in the Main Menu
    Tutorial page is now easier to navigate (scrolling fixed)
    Added colored text to Powers cost for easier understanding 


Bug Fixes

    Zen carry-over glitch fixed


Thank you everyone for playing, and keep the comments coming! Every suggestion helps us make the game better. And remember - 

DON'T

notes.title: Release Date Changes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're thrilled about the upcoming release of Don't Pray To Satan. 

Unfortunately, due to a clerical error, our game build seems to be stuck in Steam's review queue, so an April 17th release is looking to be unlikely. 

As such, we've decided to push the release back to Friday, April 20th at Midnight EST (Late Thursday night). This may seem like overkill but we think it's best to give us a solid cushion to prevent any other unforeseen issues. 

Thank you for your patience, and remember - 

DON'T
